ns2:course.label: Organization of Higher Ed
ns2:course.description: Examination of American higher education both as a system and as a field of study. Includes consideration of organizational patterns, stakeholders, governance, and the purposes of higher education.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Ed Organization and Leadership or Educ Policy, Orgzn & Leadrshp major(s). Restricted to CAS:Educ Org & Leadershp -UIUC, EDD:Educ Org & Leadershp -UIUC, EDM:Educ Org & Leadershp -UIUC, MS:Educ Org & Leadershp -UIUC, PHD:Educ Org & Leadershp -UIUC, CAS: Ed Pol Org & Ldrshp -UIUC, EDD: Ed Pol Org & Ldrshp -UIUC, EDM: Ed Pol Org & Ldrshp -UIUC, MA: Ed Pol Org & Ldrshp -UIUC, or PHD: Ed Pol Org & Ldrshp -UIUC.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Priority will be given to department majors.
